scope: Actual backend runtime image; real PostgreSQL and Redis; ASGI authenticated API requests, including response serialization. Four concurrent staff in one process. Excludes public-network latency and is not a VPS SLO. Python tracemalloc peaks sampled separately from latency runs; no synthetic rows or volumes deleted.
qualification: PERF-04 component benchmark; SCALE-03 complete workload qualified separately
source_note: Built from the candidate production Dockerfile. Subsequent coordinator-only revision lookup compatibility correction is separately covered by real PostgreSQL tests; measured staff branch is unchanged.
measurement_limits: Four concurrent staff in one ASGI process, without network/proxy/Gunicorn process overhead or external providers.
Cold four-request maximum is reported as p95; too few cold samples to infer a stable tail distribution. Warm p95/p99 use80samples percase.
Full computed-index decoding and ordered-selection construction remain proportional to group size; warm requests avoid complete SQL projection and duplicate recomputation.
Local shared Docker resource contention can affect tails. No deployment SLO or unbounded scaling claim.

Standalone ASGI teardown printed Redis connection-destructor warnings after measurements; process exit0. Request-owned roster cache connections close perrequest; this harness does not start the application lifespan.
